prompts: Production 2D GAME SPRINT ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET. Reference image supplies survivor identity ONLY: ochre hood, ivory ceramic armor, dark teal cape, amber chest organ/backpack. No seed creatures. Transparent canvas, exact FOUR columns by FIVE rows of equally sized cells (portrait aspect 4:5). Twenty full-body human sprites. FIXED elevated oblique camera. Each ROW is one direction, each COLUMN is successive sprint gait phase. Row1 SOUTH/front toward viewer. Row2 SOUTHEAST/front-right. Row3 EAST/right profile. Row4 NORTHEAST/back-right away. Row5 NORTH/full back away viewer. LEFT TO RIGHT IN EVERY ROW: 1 left leg extended forward/right leg back and opposite arms; 2 left foot pushing off/right knee passing forward; 3 right leg extended forward/left leg back, opposite of frame1; 4 right foot pushing off/left knee passing forward, opposite of frame2. Visibly different leg and arm poses, believable FAST RUN, torso forward lean, bent elbows, cape streaming behind the motion. Same exact body size, head height, hip center and ground baseline across each row. Every figure centered horizontally within its own cell. Sprite height 70% of cell, foot baseline 85%, minimum 15% transparent margin all sides; NOTHING may touch cell boundaries. Correct rotational anatomy, all bodies upright, no planar rotations. Same detailed painterly colors as reference. TRUE clean transparent background, NO colored fringe, NO shadows, NO ground, NO grid, NO labels. Layout accuracy and alternating legs are paramount.

Fix this sprint animation sheet. Preserve exact 4 columns x5 rows grid, character identity, directions and transparent background. The current sheet repeats the SAME FOOT position too often. CHANGE COLUMN 2 AND COLUMN 4 IN EVERY ROW so the running legs are REVERSED relative to their preceding frame: previously forward leg MUST go backward bent with heel up; previously trailing leg MUST become forward with knee lifted, alternate arms too. Especially the right-facing sideview third row: column1 has extended front boot at lower right; column2 MUST have that leg folded under hip and the OTHER thigh forward with knee high and boot tucked, a clearly different silhouette. Column3 opposite foot strike; column4 airborne passing pose. Top row alternating left and right knee, not the same forward leg in all four images. Last row alternate visibly which boot sole is visible, left then right. Four-frame run loop, obvious alternating scissor-leg motion. Slight cape changes only; preserve head/body scale and fixed torso position. Add generous clear cell margins, smaller character if needed, no clipping, no floor, no labels, true transparent background.
